per_clip.draft_title: Weigh Ingredients and Make Flatbread on a Griddle

ref_steps: Wait about 30 seconds for the coffee to bloom. (You will see small bubbles or foam on the coffee grounds during this step.)
Pour a small amount of water into the filter to wet the grounds
Transfer the grounds to the filter cone
spread open filter in dripper to create a cone
Place the paper filter in the dripper
pour Slowly pour the rest of the water over the grounds in a circular motion. Do not overfill beyond the top of the paper filter
Prepare the filter insert by folding the paper filter in half to create a semi-circle, and in half again to create a quarter-circle
Discard the paper filter and coffee grounds
Boil the water. (While the water is boiling, assemble the filter cone)
drain Let the coffee drain completely into the mug before removing the dripper
Grind the coffee beans until the coffee grounds are the consistency of coarse sand, about 20 seconds
Place the dripper on top of a coffee mug

check Once the water has boiled, check the temperature of the water. (The water should be between 195-205 degrees Fahrenheit or between 91-96 degrees Celsius. If the water is too hot, let it cool briefly.)
draft_steps: Add salt and other dry ingredients
Turn off stove and clean up
